fuel_consumption.source_quote: Our forecasted fuel consumption is approximately 1.59 billion gallons per year and a one cent per gallon increase in fuel price results in a $16 million annual increase in expense, excluding the impact of hedge transactions.

instrument_type_details.notes: Costless collar transactions on heating oil futures. 10% heating oil price increase would increase fair value by ~$47M; 10% decrease would decrease by ~$69M. Heating oil used as proxy for jet fuel (generally highly correlated).

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption (gallons in millions): AWA mainline 435 + US Airways mainline 775 = 1,210 (2006 combined mainline; does not include express operations)
